eps.t: The Young Jedi / Yoda's Mission
eps.o: Jedi younglings Kai, Lys, and Nubs go on their first adventure. Yoda gives the younglings a mission.

eps.t: Nash's Race Day / The Lost Jedi Ship
eps.o: Nash's Jedi friends help her compete in a race. The young Jedi find a long-lost Jedi ship.

eps.t: Get Well Nubs / The Junk Giant
eps.o: Kai and Lys seek out a cure for Nubs' illness. The young Jedi set out to catch a thief.

eps.t: Lys and the Snowy Mountain Rescue / Attack of the Training Droids
eps.o: The younglings help wrangle creatures. Kai causes problems when he attempts to program droids to clean the temple.

eps.t: The Jellyfruit Pursuit / Creature Safari
eps.o: Nash and the young Jedi pursue stolen jellyfruit. The younglings discover a bird-like creature.

eps.t: Squadron / Forest Defenders
eps.o: The Jedi put their flying skills to the test. Kai and friends defend the forest creatures' homes.

eps.t: The Jedi and the Thief / The Missing Kibbin
eps.o: Kai and Master Zia must get back her stolen ship. The young Jedi help a bounty hunter find a lost pet.

eps.t: The Girl and Her Gargantua / The Show Must Go On
eps.o: The younglings track an escaped creature. Nash's Jedi friends help reunite her favorite band.

eps.t: The Princess and the Jedi / Kai's Bad Day
eps.o: Nash and the young Jedi transport a princess. Kai's bad day worsens when a simple mission goes awry.

eps.t: Visitor's Day / The Growing Green Danger
eps.o: Jedi track down artifacts stolen from the town fair. Nubs plants a seed that grows out of control.

eps.t: The Ganguls / Bad Eggs
eps.o: Nash's Jedi friends set out to find her missing speeder. Hap's kitchen is overrun by creatures.

eps.t: Off the Rails / The Thieves of Tharnaka
eps.o: Kai and the Jedi must stop Taborr's train heist. The Jedi set out to recover a mysterious artifact.

eps.t: Tree Troubles / Big Brother's Bounty
eps.o: Nubs and the Jedi protect his favorite tree. The Jedi help a young bounty hunter find her brother.

eps.t: Charhound Chase / Creature Comforts
eps.o: Kai helps Bell find his runaway charhound. Lys gets attached to a lost wild creature.

eps.t: An Adventure with Yoda / The Talon Takeover
eps.o: Yoda teams up with the young Jedi to stop pirates. The Jedi must rescue Taborr from the Ganguls.

eps.t: Mystery of the Opal Cave / Clash
eps.o: The young Jedi investigate a haunted cave. Kai and rival Jedi Djovi team up for a mission.

eps.t: Stuck in the Muck / Junkyard Sleepover
eps.o: The Jedi respond to a distress call. The younglings investigate odd noises in the junkyard.

eps.t: The Great Leaf Glide / The Harvest Feast
eps.o: The young Jedi learn how to sky surf. Kai and his friends help a family unite for a feast.

eps.t: Life Day / Raxlo Strikes Back
eps.o: The Jedi help a Wookiee prepare for Life Day. The younglings protect wellagrin eggs from Raxlo.

eps.t: Aftershock / Feather Frenzy
eps.o: Jedi help a prince. Creatures take over Nash's garage.

eps.t: Best Friends / Happy Trails, Nubs
eps.o: Kai and Nubs team up. Nubs is captured by the Ganguls.

eps.t: The Tale of Short Spire / The Team Up
eps.o: Jedi help on Batuu. Taborr and the Jedi work together.

eps.t: The Caves of Batuu / Finders Keepers
eps.o: Kai explores a mystic cave. The Jedi help a scrapper.

eps.t: The Starship Show / Nash's Super Busy Day
eps.o: Draiven steals a ship. Kai offers to help a busy Nash.

eps.t: The Prince and the Pirate
eps.o: The Jedi must stop Taborr's plans on Starlight Beacon.
